citation_accuracy.method: Proxy validation: citation has document, valid optional chunk, non-empty snapshot fields, and source_anchor. Golden offset accuracy is not measured.
citation_accuracy.source: chat_citations joined through chat_messages/chat_sessions plus documents/document_chunks

lifecycle_compliance.method: Read-only DB check: archived/deleted chunks must not be searchable; active parsed/chunked chunks should be searchable.
lifecycle_compliance.source: documents + document_chunks and M5a lifecycle/source status findings

source_status_accuracy.method: Read-only citation source_status compared to current document lifecycle_status; missing document expects source_status=missing.

duplicate_retrieval_rate.method: Proxy validation from active document content_hash duplicates and current M5a duplicate_findings. Query-result duplicate rate is not measured.

empty_retrieval_rate.method: Read-only DB check for active searchable chunks with empty content plus M5a EMPTY_CHUNK findings.

known_risks.risk: Citation Accuracy and Source Status Accuracy have no runtime denominator in the current workspace.
known_risks.impact: Metrics are structurally defined but not empirically validated against live citations.
known_risks.m5b_input: M5b must require a golden citation fixture or benchmark workspace before treating citation metrics as release-grade.

known_risks.risk: This validation used current M5a data and read-only DB state; it did not replay the m5-retrieval-golden-v1 benchmark.
known_risks.impact: Precision/Recall/MRR and true query-result duplicate rate remain outside this report.
known_risks.m5b_input: M5b Retrieval Drift must run the golden-query benchmark as a separate gate input.

known_risks.risk: Citation Accuracy is proxy-validated via IDs and snapshots; exact source offsets are not compared against a golden dataset.
known_risks.impact: Wrong paragraph/page offsets could remain undetected until golden citation assertions exist.
known_risks.m5b_input: Add golden citation anchors with expected document_id, chunk_id, source_anchor, and quote window.

known_risks.risk: Current M5a report has 4 metadata findings.
known_risks.impact: Metadata gaps do not directly fail retrieval baseline metrics here, but can degrade filtering, source labeling, and future retrieval scoring.
known_risks.m5b_input: Metadata Drift should track whether missing fields regress further or affect retrieval filters.

required_m5b_followups: Run m5-retrieval-golden-v1 benchmark before M5b gate approval.
Add golden citation anchors for exact citation accuracy.
Promote lifecycle_compliance and source_status_accuracy to hard M5b drift inputs.
Track duplicate_retrieval_rate from actual query result sets, not only document hashes.
Keep empty_retrieval_rate as a read-only DB and retrieval-result check.
